subject: Strategic ISV referral credit policy discussion
messages:
From: Dan Marshall <dan@cloudroute.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@brightops.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner crediting — clarification on referral vs. co-sell credits

Evelyn,

Thanks for the conversation at last week's partner forum. BrightOps is excited to start routing early-stage prospects your way. Before we formalize a mutual action plan, we need to align on how referral credits will be handled when BrightOps introduces a lead that converts under a Redwood-managed PO or through our reseller channel.

Key questions from our side:
- Do referral credits apply to total contract value (TCV) or first-year ARR net of discounts?
- Is there a lead registration window (how long do we hold exclusivity)?
- What clawback terms apply if the customer churns or downgrades within a year?

We'd like a short written policy we can show our sales team and include in co-sell decks. Happy to hop on a quick call this week to iterate.

Thanks,
Dan
Dan Marshall
Head of Partnerships
CloudRoute

Attachment: none
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Dan Marshall <dan@cloudroute.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Reddy <priya@brightops.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner crediting — clarification on referral vs. co-sell credits

Dan — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and proposal below; can we schedule 30 minutes tomorrow to finalize language? I attached a short sample MAP table so your ops team can see the math.

Short answers / proposed defaults:
- Credit basis: we pilot with "first-year net ARR" (post-discount, pre-tax) for simplicity.
- Registration window: 90 days from initial registration for exclusive credit; extension by mutual written agreement.
- Clawback: prorated clawback over 12 months if account cancels or reduces >25% in the first 12 months.

Pilot specifics I propose for BrightOps:
- Referral credit: 8% of first-year net ARR for direct-referral-sourced new customers.
- Co-sell uplift: if BrightOps participates in a qualified opportunity and closed-won credited, add 2% (total 10%) subject to joint-attestation of involvement.
- Annual cap for credits in first year: $75k per partner to limit downside during ramp.

Action items:
1) Confirm you can accept the 90-day registration window and 12-month prorated clawback.
2) Share any procurement constraints from your side (e.g., your customers requiring channel invoices to flow differently).
3) If agreed, we'll draft a one-page SOW addendum and a referral credit schedule.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Channel Sales (acting)
Redwood Inference

Looping in a couple of operational points from Rev Ops:
- Lead registration cutoff should be defined by HubSpot timestamp + partner-provided registration form. We should require minimal fields: company domain, estimated ACV, lead source.
- For crediting, Rev Ops needs to see the first closed opportunity owner and the invoice flow. If the customer is invoiced by a reseller, crediting rules change (we credit the reseller unless partner has an explicit co-sell tag).
- Please note: credits that exceed $10k in a quarter require finance signoff (AML/credit controls).

I'll prep a short HubSpot workflow and a sample registration form we can embed in the partner portal.

—Ben

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of notes from BrightOps: we can accept first-year net ARR for the pilot, but a few enterprise customers require crediting on invoiced amounts only (their procurement teams won't allow a partner to receive a percentage of list price). Will that block the reseller path?

Also, the $75k cap is reasonable for year one. Can we have a monthly tracking dashboard (read-only) to monitor credits and cap consumption? That will help our AE managers.

We can sign off on the 90-day window and 12-month prorated clawback if the SOW includes an explicit dispute resolution period (30 days) and a single escalation point at Redwood Rev Ops.

DocuSign request: if you draft the addendum, send as a DocuSign envelope and we'll route internally.

Thanks all — great alignment. I'm approving a 3-month pilot with BrightOps under the terms Evelyn outlined with the following binding decisions:

- Pilot credit: 8% first-year net ARR for registered referrals; co-sell participation +2% when jointly documented.
- Registration window: 90 days. Disputes: 30-day review window; Rev Ops is the escalation owner.
- Clawback: 12-month prorated, triggered if ARR reduction >25% during the first 12 months.
- Admin: Ben, please publish a partner registration form and meter cap consumption; Evelyn, please send the one-page addendum to BrightOps for DocuSign.

I'll also authorize a one-off exception to the $10k finance signoff for BrightOps for the pilot (so we don't block early momentum) — finance retains final sign-off if credits exceed $50k.

Evelyn/Ben: please copy legal on the addendum draft (legal@redwood.com) and include the HubSpot workflow link.

Laura Bennett
